import type { ReactNode } from "react"
import { redirect } from "next/navigation"
import { AdminShell } from "@/components/admin/admin-shell"
import { AdminQueryProvider } from "@/components/admin/query-provider"
import { AdminThemeProvider } from "@/components/admin/theme-provider"
import { hasAdminSession } from "@/lib/auth/server"

export default async function AdminLayout({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  if (!await hasAdminSession()) redirect({{FIZZYX_LOGIN_ROUTE}})
  return <AdminThemeProvider><AdminQueryProvider><AdminShell>{children}</AdminShell></AdminQueryProvider></AdminThemeProvider>
}
